long_biography.plain_text:
Scheinberg grew up in Israel and moved with his family to the Toronto area as a teenager. His father Isai, a computer programmer and poker enthusiast, developed the technical concept; Mark joined him in launching PokerStars and assumed commercial leadership. As chief executive, he helped turn the site into the largest online-poker business and became the controlling shareholder of Rational Group.

The family's sale of Rational gave Mark more than $3 billion and ended his operating role in online gaming. He established Mohari to redeploy that capital through hospitality and real-estate investments. Its model combines acquisitions and development with active operational oversight, and its portfolio has expanded into luxury lodging, restaurants, nightlife and wellness. Scheinberg remains Mohari's founder and principal.
